# Slidestalk

> A tech conference and meetup platform for sharing presentations, discussing innovations, and connecting with developer communities across China.

Slidestalk aggregates tech talks, conference presentations, and local meetup events focused on emerging technologies like AI, databases, cloud-native systems, and open-source projects. The platform serves as a hub for technical knowledge sharing across major Chinese cities.

## Key Topics

- Tech Meetups
- Open-Source
- Database Technology
- AI/ML
- Cloud-Native
- eBPF
- Cloud Computing
- Developer Community
- Beijing
- Shanghai
- Hangzhou
- Shenzhen
- Guangzhou
- openGauss
- Big Data

## Core Platform

- [Homepage](https://www.slidestalk.com): Slidestalk homepage: tech conference platform for sharing and discussion
- [Popular Documents](https://www.slidestalk.com/slides/popular): Popular documents directory featuring tech content and presentations
- [Tech Series & Conferences](https://www.slidestalk.com/series): Tech series and conference listings: ApacheCon, Spark+AI, Pulsar

## Major City Meetups

- [Beijing Tech Meetup](https://www.slidestalk.com/meetups/0): Beijing tech meetup: NebulaGraph, GraphRAG, OpenVINO events
- [Shanghai Tech Meetup](https://www.slidestalk.com/meetups/1): Shanghai tech meetup: eBPF, AI/ML, database technology events
- [Guangzhou Tech Salon](https://www.slidestalk.com/meetups/2): Guangzhou tech salon: AIGC, openEuler, OceanBase events
- [Shenzhen Tech Meetup](https://www.slidestalk.com/meetups/3): Shenzhen tech meetup: AI, cloud computing, observability events
- [Hangzhou Tech Meetup](https://www.slidestalk.com/meetups/5): Hangzhou tech meetup: OSC conference, StarRocks, open-source
- [Chengdu Tech Meetup](https://www.slidestalk.com/meetups/7): Chengdu tech meetup: cloud, AI, open-source, database events
